entities.name: CTP synthase
observations: EC 6.3.4.2; reviewed homologs are annotated as homotetramers and cytosolic enzymes.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent amination of UTP to CTP using L-glutamine or ammonia as nitrogen source.
The glutamine-dependent overall reaction is UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O → CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + 2 H+.
The enzyme can also support ammonia-dependent CTP formation: UTP + NH4+ + ATP → CTP + ADP + phosphate + 2 H+.
The glutaminase half-reaction is L-glutamine + H2O → L-glutamate + NH4+.
Functions in de novo pyrimidine/CTP biosynthesis.
